behavior: One extraction batch returns to coverage assessment; adequate evidence advances dependencies before unnecessary further extraction.
When coverage is missing, unreviewed already-read passages run before targeted search and do not consume a requery round.
Whole pending passages are removed from an oversized batch; literal evidence is not clipped to fit and the repair reserve is not borrowed.
Each batch-specific assessment input is frozen under its evidence/review identity, while exact confirmed pairs reuse prior verdicts.
Empty, invalid and truncated responses remain reviewed and cannot be automatically resent after repository reconstruction.
The immutable contract applies only to new runs. Graph step allowance accommodates batch/frontier routing without changing any call/token/time limit.
boundary: Compiled graph and SQLite routing with fixed model fixtures. D1-v10 proved dependent dispatch but did not pass content review.
